name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
candidate:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have ap {a b c d : List CoreIdent} (h : a ⊆ c) (h' : b ⊆ d) :=
    List.append_subset.mpr ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h,
      List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ h'⟩
  intro h
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar => exact List.Subset.empty
  | abs _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ ih₁ ih₂
  | eq _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ap ih₁ ih₂
  | app _ _ hn ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact List.Subset.refl _
    · next hfalse =>
      exfalso
      cases hn .oldPred
      exact hfalse _ _ _ rfl
    · exact ap ihfn ihe
  | ite _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => exact ap (ap ih₁ ih₂) ih₃
